members.name: holidays
doc: Stage 2: the holiday rows I return for a holiday list query.

members.name: holidayDetails
doc: Structured "when is X" / "is this a holiday" layout; it mirrors AnalyticsPayload.holidayDetails.

members.name: holidayCompare
doc: Structured year comparison that I draw as a card. It mirrors AnalyticsPayload.holidayCompare.

members.name: lead
doc: One-line lead that I put above the holiday card. It mirrors AnalyticsPayload.lead.

members.name: notice
doc: Set when the question had a second part that I did not answer. It mirrors AnalyticsPayload.notice.

members.name: ask
doc: A clarifying question about a department word with more than one meaning (step 49a). It is the same type as AnalyticsPayload.ask.

members.name: hospital
doc: A hospital OPD answer (step 51a), drawn as a card by HospitalAnswerCard. I use the same type in AnalyticsPayload (backend) and AnalyticsAnswer (frontend).

members.name: employeeAdmin
doc: Set when the employee manager was asked for by someone who may use it (step 66a); EmployeeAdminPanel draws it as a panel. The same type is used in AnalyticsPayload (backend) and AnalyticsAnswer (frontend).

members.name: paxAdmin
doc: Set when the PAX directory editor was asked for by someone who may use it (step 64a); PaxAdminPanel draws it as a panel. The same type is used in AnalyticsPayload (backend) and AnalyticsAnswer (frontend).

members.name: holidayAdmin
doc: The Holiday Manager was asked for by someone who may use it; I draw it as a panel with HolidayAdminPanel.

members.name: circularAdmin
doc: The Circular Manager was asked for by someone who may use it; I draw it as a panel with CircularAdminPanel.

members.name: announcementAdmin
doc: The Announcement Manager was asked for by someone who may use it; I draw it as a panel with AnnouncementAdminPanel.

members.name: accessLogAdmin
doc: The Contact Access Log was asked for by someone who may use it; I draw it as a panel with AccessLogAdminPanel.

members.name: managementHub
doc: The management page (the titles of the management tools this person may open); ManagementHubPanel draws it.

members.name: managementGate
doc: The management page was asked for by someone who may not have it: I show the card that asks him to sign in, or tells him he is not authorised (ManagementGatePanel).

members.name: headline
doc: The ONE clean answer shown first, big and bold (step 61a). I use the same type in AnalyticsPayload (backend) and AnalyticsAnswer (frontend).

members.name: typeBreakdown
members.type: { type: string; label: string; count: number }[]
doc: Per-type (RH/CH/FH) tally for a holiday list query; I only fill it when no single type was already filtered on. `count` above is the DISTINCT-holiday number; rawEntryCount is the raw (date,type) row total, and `count` deliberately avoids its double-counting. It mirrors AnalyticsPayload in src/lib/employees/analytics.ts: keep the two in sync if either changes.

members.name: rhQuotaByCategory
doc: Per-category RH quota (holiday_rh_quota), which I send alongside a holiday list.

members.name: categoryLabels
doc: What A/B/C/D actually mean; see CATEGORY_LABEL in holidays/terms.ts.

members.name: pendingPatternId
doc: Present only on answers from a fresh, not-yet-trusted LLM-derived pattern: I show the tick/cross and report feedback with this id. It mirrors AnalyticsPayload.pendingPatternId (employees/analytics.ts).

members.name: interpretation
doc: Plain-language statement of how I understood an LLM-derived query. It mirrors AnalyticsPayload.interpretation.

members.name: nl2sql
doc: Present when the language model wrote the answer (SQL, departments covered, tick/cross, and a table for breakdowns). See src/lib/nl2sql/omnibar.ts.

members.name: source
doc: Which route produced the answer; I record the footer's Yes/No against it.

members.name: attempt
doc: I send 1 for the first answer and 2 for a second attempt after a "No" ...

members.name: feedbackLogId
doc: The log row to rate, also for explanations that carry no SQL.
